description: Defines the XFontWeight struct, representing the density of a typeface in terms of stroke heaviness, including comparison operators, conversions, and helpers related to font weights within the PDFsharp library.

classes.name: XFontWeight
classes.description: A struct representing the weight (density) of a font, with comparison operations, formatting, and conversion utilities.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares two XFontWeight instances based on their Weight property.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks if the current XFontWeight is equal to another instance.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on the Weight property.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the font weight.

methods.name: ConvertToString
methods.description: Internal method to convert the font weight to string, possibly using a friendly name.

methods.name: FromGdiFontStyle
methods.description: Creates an XFontWeight from a GDI font style, mapping styles to weights.
